* fix: prevent yay/pacman description text from leaking into package name candidates

yay -Ss and pacman -Ss output was parsed assuming exactly 2 lines per
package (header + description). Newer yay versions default to single-line

to be consumed as the current package's description, and description
fragments to be misidentified as package names.

is consumed as a description only when it does not match the header regex.
